settings.name: outreach_url
settings.label: Outreach URL
settings.description: The outreach service's base URL, such as https://outreach.example.test. Use https anywhere but this computer.

settings.name: outreach_token
settings.label: Project API token
settings.description: An API token from the console's Tokens screen. It holds one project and one role; give it the least role the agents need (Viewer to report, Sender to draft and test).

setup.description: Checks that the outreach program is installed and on PATH by running outreach --version. It downloads nothing and needs no disk; it needs Python 3.
